feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 September 2026 4:23pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Wednesday, 16 September 2026 at 4:00pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds developing.


##Synopsis##

Deep area of low pressure in the Atlantic will drive frontal systems across the area later today and tonight.


##Wind##

West or Southwest 4 or 5, increasing Southwest 5 or 6 later this evening and at first tonight, occasionally 7, then veering West 5 or 6 later in the night. Little change tomorrow morning and afternoon, although possibly touching 7 in a few places at times.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, soon becoming mostly moderate, and perhaps occasionally rough in the east of the area.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain arriving from the west for a time, isolated showers tomorrow.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 5 or 6, decreasing West or Southwest 4 or 5 for a time around dawn on Friday, before backing South or Southwest 5 to 7 on Friday morning. Veering West or Southwest in the afternoon.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming moderate or rough later.


##Weather##

Fair, then rain later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in rain later.
